notes: Nearly every Hanyang host (www, oia, gsis, grad, engineering, cs, business, urban, erica) disallows our tool via robots.txt, so Seoul-campus international graduate eligibility, language scores (TOEFL/IELTS/TOPIK) and Spring/Fall 2027 windows could not be read. The ERICA international admissions site (studyerica) publishes the graduate guideline only as a PDF (download.php?ds_no=6; per-term guideline PDFs), and the MBA school sends foreign applicants to OIA, so no HTML dates or scores were available; the MBA 2027 special-admission window (2026.10.15-10.29) is for domestic applicants and was not recorded. GBM and Global YES MBA tracks are marked closed and were left out. Useful PDF-only sources: 2024 Fall/2024 Spring Hanyang graduate admission guideline PDFs at oia.hanyang.ac.kr/files/attach/filebox/ and ERICA per-term English guidelines.
